aboutMe.text: Motivated and detail-oriented Mechanical Engineering student with a strong interest in engineering design, manufacturing, and problem-solving. Currently developing a solid foundation in mechanical systems, materials, CAD, and engineering principles through academic study and practical projects. A reliable and analytical team player with a willingness to learn, take on new challenges, and apply theoretical knowledge to real-world engineering problems. Seeking opportunities to gain practical experience and further develop technical skills within the engineering industry.
